records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.loading_screen.LoadingScreen.blow_away#1
records.source: The logo holds until half a second after the cover first painted (at once when called later than that), then blows away over four seconds: the black container fades from one to three seconds in and the last tile has gone at four. The cover deletes itself then.
records.translation: Le logo reste jusqu’à une demi-seconde après la première peinture de la couverture (aussitôt si appelé plus tard), puis s’envole sur quatre secondes : le conteneur noir s’efface de la première à la troisième seconde et la dernière tuile est partie à quatre. La couverture se supprime alors d’elle-même.
records.context: The logo holds until half a second after the cover first painted (at once when called later than that), then blows away over four seconds: the black container fades from one to three seconds in and the last tile has gone at four. The cover deletes itself then.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.loading_screen.replay_startup_animation#1
records.source: Help > Show startup animation. The black container with the logo comes back over the window, holds for half a second and blows away as it does at startup. It plays even when Preferences > Appearance > Animation > Startup animation is off; under Preferences > Appearance > Accessibility > Reduce motion the logo holds and then cross-fades away in one second. A click or a key skips it. The window's size, state and keyboard focus are left as they were.
records.translation: Aide > Afficher l’animation de démarrage. Le conteneur noir portant le logo réapparaît par-dessus la fenêtre, reste une demi-seconde puis se disperse comme au démarrage. L’animation se joue même si Préférences > Apparence > Animation > Animation de démarrage est désactivé ; avec Préférences > Apparence > Accessibilité > Réduire les mouvements, le logo reste affiché puis disparaît par fondu en une seconde. Un clic ou une touche permet de passer l’animation. La taille, l’état et le focus clavier de la fenêtre sont conservés.
records.context: Help > Show startup animation. The black container with the logo comes back over the window, holds for half a second and blows away as it does at startup. It plays even when Preferences > Appearance > Animation > Startup animation is off; under Preferences > Appearance > Accessibility > Reduce motion the logo holds and then cross-fades away in one second. A click or a key skips it. The window's size, state and keyboard focus are left as they were.
